plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Stanley (28 June 1935, Science 81: 644–645), Bawden & Pirie (19 December 1936, Nature 138: 1051–1052), and Ruska & Kausche (May 1939, Naturwissenschaften 27: 292–299) TMV composition & electron-microscope resolution chart shows visible-light microscopy limit (~200 nm) vs electron-microscope imaging of 300 x 18 nm TMV rods (95% protein coat + 5% RNA core, infectious at 10^-9 g/mL).

teach_overlay.scale: a tobacco mosaic virus is ten times smaller than the wavelength of green light, making it physically invisible to any optical microscope on Earth until Helmut Ruska used a beam of electrons to photograph it in 1939
